educationalGoal: In modern society, a large amount of data can be easily collected due to the development of information technology. An academic field that statistically analyzes and evaluates a large amount of data is called data science. In this course, we will conduct practical exercises and understand the mathematical meaning of statistical analysis of numerical data, which is a basic method of data science. Also, learn statistical processing methods and expression techniques using computer software such as R and Python.
advice: This is a basic course in statistics. We will cover the following topics: 1. Data science. 2. Mathematical meaning of probability . 3. Probability distributions. 4. Data analysis methods using statistics. Students are expected to understand that measurement data in an experiment have variation and that this variation is a variable associated with a stochastic phenomenon. Students are expected to understand the normal distribution as a common probability distribution function. Students are expected to learn statistics in data analysis, including correlation and regression analysis. Students are expected to analyze data using Excel (computer spreadsheet software). Students are expected to complete the exercises on their own and not copy/consult with others.
